assets.name: pixel-calico-cat
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent pixel art mascot sprite for SchedSnap
Primary request: one cute calico kitten with cream chest and face, charcoal gray and muted apricot patches, upright ears and curled tail, full character sitting centered with generous clear margins. Tiny expressive square dark eyes and small face. Image reference is STYLE GUIDANCE only: match its chunky square pixel clusters, warm muted low-saturation palette, limited stepped shading, retro game sprite craftsmanship.

Scene: genuinely transparent alpha background. Single isolated full-body character.
